conflicts.permit: When you use the App, we or our third party business partners may access, assign, collect, monitor and/or remotely store one or more unique identifiers, such as a universally unique identifier (UUID).
conflicts.prohibit: We do not collect any Personal Data (defined as any information about you, which is, or can be, identified, even indirectly, by reference to any other information, including a personal identification number) when you simply use the App without logging in.
conflicts.situation: A user simply uses the app without logging in, and unique device identifiers (which fall under indirect personal identification numbers) are collected.
conflicts.reason: The policy defines personal data broadly to include indirect identifiers, yet permits collecting unique identifiers while simultaneously stating no personal data is collected without logging in.
